members.name: value
members.description: Select is a direct alias of SelectPrimitive.Root, not a native select wrapper. Generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange distinguish single Value|null from multiple arrays. open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/onOpenChangeComplete are independent of selected value; default modal=true. Root name/form/required/autoComplete use its hidden form control; object labels/form values use itemToStringLabel/itemToStringValue and comparison uses isItemEqualToValue. SelectValue resolves labels from Root items or registered ItemText; it is not a label for the field. Trigger defaults native button role=combobox with size sm|default. Content defaults bottom/center, offsets4/0 and alignItemWithTrigger=true; it inserts scroll arrows and List automatically. Items are role=option; disabled entries can be focused but cannot commit, while closed typeahead skips disabled choices. Single commit requests closing separately, even if the value callback is canceled; multiple toggles array values and normally stays open. readOnly locks changes but deliberately allows opening/browsing. GroupLabel/Separator are actual primitive parts; no text-query input, filter, server fetch or custom command event is invented.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Actual source selected-value callback; canceled candidate and controlled props preserve selected authority, independent of closing/query transactions.
